_note: Authored content for the SSV Silver Gull shop module. Shipped in the module and OVERWRITTEN on every release - never store shop stock, prices paid, or money here. Live state lives in the world settings (shops / locations / treasury / catalogueOverrides). Regenerate with tools/build_catalogue.py.

shopTypes.label: General Store
blurbs: Crates stacked to the ceiling and a clerk who has seen everything.
Everything a spacer needs and nothing they want.

shopTypes.label: Fuel Depot
blurbs: Pumps, drums and a hard-eyed dispatcher counting every litre.
The whole place smells of promethium and burnt insulation.

shopTypes.label: Ship Chandler
blurbs: Coiled line, patch kits and second-hand nav gear in every corner.
If it bolts to a hull, they have one — probably used.

shopTypes.label: Weaponsmith
blurbs: Racked barrels behind armoured glass, and a bench that is always busy.
The smith talks to the guns more than the customers.

shopTypes.label: Armoury
blurbs: Plate, weave and pressure suits hung like empty crew.
Everything here is rated for something that wants you dead.

shopTypes.label: Med Bay / Apothecary
blurbs: Clean light, clean counters, and prices that are anything but.
A tired medic who charges for the sterile field as well.

shopTypes.label: Cantina & Bar
blurbs: Low light, loud company, and a bar that has been wiped since last year.
Somebody is always about to start something.

shopTypes.label: Black Market
blurbs: No sign, no records, and two people watching the door.
Whatever the law forbids, somebody here has three of.

shopTypes.label: Smuggler's Hold
blurbs: A cargo hold with the manifest torn out.
Sealed crates, false floors and no questions.

shopTypes.label: Fence
blurbs: They will take anything. They will not tell you where it goes.
A jeweller's loupe and absolutely no curiosity.

shopTypes.label: Pawn Shop
blurbs: Other people's worst days, priced by the shelf.
Tickets in the window, most of them long expired.

shopTypes.label: Salvage Yard
blurbs: Hull sections stacked like a card house, sorted by nothing at all.
Cutting torches all day, every day.

shopTypes.label: Refinery / Ore Broker
blurbs: Assay scales, sample drills and a broker who never blinks.
The floor is warm and the air tastes of metal.

shopTypes.label: Exotic Artificer
blurbs: Half a workshop, half a shrine, and everything hums.
They will not say where the parts come from.

shopTypes.label: Ancient Relics
blurbs: Lit cases, soft voices, and prices spoken rather than written.
Every piece has a story and none of them check out.

shopTypes.label: Shipwright
blurbs: Gantries, welders, and a yard boss with a very full schedule.
They quote in weeks and mean months.

shopTypes.label: Vacc-Suit Outfitter
blurbs: Suits on rails, seals tested in front of you.
The fitter measures twice and charges once.

shopTypes.label: Bounty Office
blurbs: A board of faces, half of them crossed out.
Warrants, writs, and a clerk who counts heads for a living.

shopTypes.label: Temple Commissary
blurbs: Alms, bread and blessings — all of them itemised.
The acolyte prices your soul with the rest of it.

shopTypes.label: Directorate Quartermaster
blurbs: Requisition forms in triplicate and a very short queue.
Military surplus, cheap — if they will serve you at all.

shopTypes.label: Water Broker
blurbs: Sealed tanks under guard, sold by the litre.
Here, water is the only currency that never inflates.

shopTypes.label: Casino Cage
blurbs: Chips in, markers out, and the house always smiling.
The cage buys what the tables took.

shopTypes.label: Travelling Peddler
blurbs: A hold-full of odds and ends, docked for one day only.
Buys low somewhere else, sells high right here.

locations.name: Halberd's Rest
locations.blurb: Free port in the gutted hull of a Directorate dreadnought, parked beside The Coil.

locations.name: Sundowner
locations.blurb: A rogue starless world lit end to end by one endless casino city.

locations.name: Gallows Reach
locations.blurb: Pirate lords, bounty boards, and prizes fenced before the hull cools.

locations.name: Cindermoor
locations.blurb: Volcanic refinery world where the cartels cook thermite and reactor fuel.

locations.name: Ossuary
locations.blurb: A settlement built inside a ship graveyard, cutting hulls apart for a living.

locations.name: Tarn
locations.blurb: Frozen cryo-mining world. Cheap labour, cheaper ice, no questions.

locations.name: Marrow
locations.blurb: Desert world where water is the black-market currency and everything else is cheap.

locations.name: Greenhollow
locations.blurb: Jungle world veined with verdite, contested by prospector gangs.

locations.name: Sib Vael
locations.blurb: Ocean world of smuggler coves, floating markets and famous brews.

locations.name: Bexley's Landing
locations.blurb: An ordinary frontier town-world: farms, a spaceport bar, an outgunned sheriff.

locations.name: The Choir
locations.blurb: Shrine world of the Apostles of the Threshold, out on the rim.

locations.name: Ferrum Hold
locations.blurb: A Directorate-leaning mining holding, buying ore and loyalty in equal measure.

locations.name: The Coil
locations.blurb: The working ancient hyper-gate — the busiest point in the Expanse.

locations.name: Vorrn-7
locations.blurb: A frontier system on the edge of the crew's scanned space.

locations.name: Keth Minor Cluster
locations.blurb: Scattered rocks and rift static. Barely a waypoint.

locations.name: Docked at the Silver Gull
locations.blurb: Somebody has docked alongside and opened their hold.

items.name: Oxygen Canister

items.name: Verdite Shard

items.name: Terran Navy Rum
items.desc: Standard-issue naval rum ration.

items.name: Verdite Moonshine
items.desc: Glowing-green rotgut distilled near verdite deposits. Risky.

items.name: Plasmoid Fizz
items.desc: A gelatinous fizzing novelty drink; G.L.I.M.M.-approved.

items.name: Asteroid-Ice Vodka
items.desc: Clean vodka cut with meltwater from asteroid ice.

items.name: Nebula Wine, Red
items.desc: A deep red vintage with a faint stellar shimmer.

items.name: Nebula Wine, White
items.desc: A crisp pale wine with a faint stellar shimmer.

items.name: Hyperfold Whiskey
items.desc: Smoky amber whiskey; folds go down smoother after one.

items.name: Bugbear Black Ale
items.desc: A heavy, bitter black ale — Baldy's preferred.

items.name: Concord Lager
items.desc: Mass-market UGC lager in a ration can.

items.name: Rift-Berry Cider
items.desc: Tart sparkling cider from off-world rift-berries.

items.name: Void-Spiced Brandy
items.desc: A warming, heavily spiced brandy.

items.name: Cadet's Cheap Grog
items.desc: The training-ship rotgut. Cheap, strong, regrettable.

items.name: Meteor Mead
items.desc: Honeyed mead with a smoky mineral finish.

items.name: Terran Navy Ration Pack
items.desc: A full flavoured field-ration pack; a step up from bars.

items.name: Protein-Paste Tube
items.desc: Squeezable nutrient paste. Sustaining, not enjoyable.

items.name: Freeze-Dried Meal Brick
items.desc: Just add water; a full meal expands from a brick.

items.name: Nutrient Bar
items.desc: Dense ration bar; a day's calories in a wrapper.

items.name: Gobby's Stew
items.desc: A big pot of Gobby's ever-simmering ship stew.

items.name: Fresh-Print Fruit
items.desc: Food-printer fruit; convincing, mostly.

items.name: Caf Pods
items.desc: Single-serve caf pods for the ship's brewer.

items.name: Tortle Sea-Greens
items.desc: Dried edible sea-greens Gobby packs by the crate.

items.name: Water Ration
items.desc: A sealed litre of drinkable water. On Marrow, this is money.
items.art: a sealed clear plastic water ration pouch with a blue cap and a printed volume band

items.name: Cryo Ice Block
items.desc: A hauled block of mining ice; melts down to clean water.
items.art: a rough block of pale blue mining ice banded with a metal carry strap, faintly frosted

items.name: Recycler Cartridge
items.desc: Filter cartridge for a suit or galley water recycler. Wears out fast.
items.art: a cylindrical water-recycler filter cartridge, white housing with a blue fluid window and screw threads

items.name: Atmospheric Condenser Still
items.desc: Pulls drinkable water out of thin, bad air. Slowly.
items.art: a compact folding atmospheric water condenser with a collection bottle, coiled pipes and a small solar fin

items.name: Polymorphic Polymer
items.desc: Shape-holding smart polymer; a turret mount cannot be built without it.
items.art: a slab of iridescent shape-memory smart polymer, semi-translucent and slowly rippling, on a metal frame

items.name: Quantum Relay
items.desc: Entangled targeting relay. Fire-control systems are useless without one.
items.art: a small sealed quantum relay module, a gold-cased cube with a glowing blue entanglement core and pin contacts

items.name: Hyper-Dense Refined Thermite
items.desc: Cindermoor-grade thermite, compressed until it is almost a metal.
items.art: a dense dark-grey thermite brick with orange glowing seams and hazard banding

items.name: Ceruleum Ferrocrystal
items.desc: Blue-veined structural crystal; the Gull's hull and turret rings are cut from it.
items.art: a cut structural crystal ingot, steel-grey shot through with glowing cerulean blue veins

items.name: Ferrocrystal Hull Plate
items.desc: A curved section of hull plating, cut to standard frame spacing.
items.art: a curved starship hull plate section, blue-grey ferrocrystal with bolt holes and a scorched edge

items.name: Pressure Seal Gasket
items.desc: Rings out an airlock or a cracked bulkhead seam.
items.art: a thick black pressure seal gasket ring with a gold inner band

items.name: Power Coupling
items.desc: Heavy conduit coupling; the first thing to burn out under overcharge.
items.art: a heavy starship power coupling, a short thick conduit with gold contact rings and ceramic insulators

items.name: Coolant Loop
items.desc: Closed cryo loop for a reactor or a hard-firing turret.
items.art: a coiled cryogenic coolant loop, chrome tubing frosted white with a blue fluid reservoir

items.name: Manoeuvring Thruster Nozzle
items.desc: Replacement bell for an attitude thruster. Ships fly sideways without them.
items.art: a starship manoeuvring thruster nozzle bell, scorched metal cone with mounting collar

items.name: Sensor Array Module
items.desc: Restores internal and short-range external sensing.
items.art: a starship sensor array module, a flat panel of blue lenses and antenna stubs in a gold frame

items.name: Gyro Stabiliser
items.desc: Keeps a hull from tumbling when the shields take a side hit.
items.art: a starship gyro stabiliser, a heavy gimballed brass-and-steel flywheel assembly

items.name: Turret Ring Mount
items.desc: The bare rotating ring a turret bolts into. Six of these are still empty.
items.art: a heavy circular turret ring mount, a toothed rotating bearing race in blue-grey metal

items.name: Targeting Servo
items.desc: Traverse motor and fire-control linkage for a gun mount.
items.art: a compact targeting servo motor with a geared output shaft and a glowing status light

items.name: Shield Emitter Node
items.desc: One node of a deflector grid. The Gull's are all dark.
items.art: a starship shield emitter node, a faceted blue crystal set in a gold emitter housing

items.name: Slug Magazine
items.desc: Standard kinetic rounds for a slug pistol or rifle.
items.art: a boxed kinetic slug magazine with brass-tipped rounds visible through a slot

items.name: Heavy Slug Box
items.desc: Armour-piercing rounds. Hard on the barrel, harder on the target.
items.art: an open box of heavy armour-piercing slug rounds, dark steel with red tips

items.name: Weapon Energy Cell
items.desc: Snap-in charge pack for an energy sidearm.
items.art: a small snap-in weapon energy cell, a flat cartridge glowing teal along one edge

items.name: Breaching Rounds
items.desc: Door-openers. Illegal on most orderly stations.
items.art: a strip of heavy breaching shotgun shells, red casings with brass caps

items.name: Frag Grenade
items.desc: Standard fragmentation grenade. Three are already aboard.
items.art: a military fragmentation grenade, segmented olive body with a gold pin and lever

items.name: Micro-Missile Pod
items.desc: Reload pod for a light ship-mounted launcher.
items.art: a starship micro-missile reload pod, a boxed cluster of four small white missiles

items.name: Trauma Wrap
items.desc: Self-adhering bandage that clots on contact.
items.art: a rolled self-adhering trauma bandage in a sterile blue wrapper

items.name: Antitox Shot
items.desc: Broad-spectrum antitoxin injector.
items.art: a medical antitoxin auto-injector, a slim white syringe with a green fluid window

items.name: Burn Gel Tube
items.desc: For plasma flash and coolant burns. Every engine room has one.
items.art: a squeezed tube of medical burn gel, white and orange with a blue cap

items.name: Bone-Knit Ampoule
items.desc: Accelerated fracture repair. Extremely unpleasant.
items.art: a glass medical ampoule of pale bone-knit serum in a padded case

items.name: Rad-Purge Tabs
items.desc: Chelating tablets for rift and reactor exposure.
items.art: a blister strip of chalky rad-purge tablets with a radiation trefoil printed on the foil

items.name: Field Surgery Kit
items.desc: Clamps, sealant and a very steady hand.
items.art: an open field surgery kit case with sterile instruments in foam and a folded blue cloth

items.name: Grav-Line Spool
items.desc: Fifty metres of line with a magnetic anchor. Works in zero g.
items.art: a spool of thin silver grav-line with a magnetic anchor hook clipped to it

items.name: Glow Rod Bundle
items.desc: Snap-and-shake light sticks. Six hours each.
items.art: a bundle of glowing teal chemical light rods bound with a strap

items.name: Mag-Boots
items.desc: Hull-walking boots. Slow, but you stay attached.
items.art: a pair of heavy magnetic hull-walking boots, grey with gold sole plates and status lights

items.name: Tool Harness
items.desc: Chest rig that keeps a spanner from drifting off.
items.art: a worn canvas tool harness with loops, clips and a small pouch

items.name: Portable Arc Welder
items.desc: Cuts salvage apart and puts hull plate back together.
items.art: a handheld arc welder with a glowing blue tip, trigger grip and a coiled cable

items.name: Distress Beacon
items.desc: Screams your position at anyone listening. Use with care.
items.art: a rugged orange distress beacon puck with a stubby antenna and a red flashing light

items.name: Sealed Cargo Crate
items.desc: Standard sealed crate. What is in it is your business.
items.art: a sealed grey starship cargo crate with blue banding and a latched lid

items.name: Helmet Seal Ring
items.desc: The part that fails first, and fatally.

items.art: a coiled orange EVA safety tether with two steel carabiners

items.name: Suit Heater Core
items.desc: Keeps a suit survivable on the cold side of a hull.
items.art: a small suit heater core cartridge glowing warm orange in a metal sleeve

items.name: Void-Plate Vest
items.desc: Composite vest rated for shrapnel and micrometeorite alike.
items.art: a composite armoured vest in blue-grey plates with gold trim, hung on a stand

items.name: Composite Carapace
items.desc: Full boarding-action plate. Heavy, loud, effective.
items.art: a full suit of sci-fi composite carapace armour, blue-grey plate with gold edging

items.name: Slug Pistol
items.desc: Ubiquitous kinetic sidearm. Salvaged ones are everywhere.
items.art: a compact kinetic slug pistol, blue-grey frame with a gold slide and worn grip

items.name: Hunting Rifle
items.desc: Long kinetic rifle, favoured on frontier worlds.
items.art: a long-barrelled hunting rifle with a wooden stock and a small optical scope

items.name: Arc Cutter
items.desc: A salvage tool that people keep using on each other.

items.desc: UGC scrip. Worth something wherever the Concord still means anything.
items.art: an engraved bearer bond certificate with blue guilloche printing and a gold seal

items.desc: Someone else's route data, sold twice over.

items.name: Unlicensed AI Core

items.art: an unlicensed AI core, a black cube with a restless amber light inside a cracked casing

items.name: Bounty Writ
items.desc: A name, a face, and a number.

items.name: Trade Permit

items.art: an official trade permit card with holographic banding and a gold crest

items.name: Sector Star Chart
items.desc: One sector, properly surveyed. Worth more than it looks.
items.art: a rolled star chart showing a spiral of star systems in blue and gold ink

items.name: Salvaged Nav Core
items.desc: Pulled from a dead ship. Might still hold someone's last route.
items.art: a scorched salvaged navigation computer core, a dented box with torn cabling

items.desc: Real spice, off a real planet. Gobby will pay over the odds.
items.art: an ornate small spice tin, gold-lidded with deep red spice heaped inside

items.name: Bolt of Voidsilk
items.desc: Shimmering fabric that never quite settles on a colour.
items.art: a rolled bolt of iridescent voidsilk fabric shifting between blue and violet
